evidence: The verified completion repair improves union wealth and fills but the same selected support policy still fails common-five wealth. Reconstructing all 2181 selected pre-2026 actual closes reproduces archived targets and reconciles daily PnL. Across union/common-five/leader-removal, 99/89/98 symbol-close observations have current entry eligibility and three fresh healthy trend closes but are still vetoed by the old three-consecutive-full-entry counter. Of these,16/37/7 have a vacancy, positive account cap and no protective cut; this is structural opportunity, not proof of cash/risk/sector-funded executable orders. Outcomes are overlapping and mixed. On2023-03-21 common-five, one higher-scored recovered eligible name remains vetoed while two other names receive the slots. No date or symbol is a policy exception.
hypothesis: Distinguish confirmation of restored trend health from the separate purchase trigger. Requiring the full breakout/persistence admission predicate on every confirmation close can postpone an otherwise healthy leader until its slot is occupied. Counting fresh above-fast-average healthy closes may reduce that unintended opportunity loss without bypassing the full entry trigger or account risk authority.
health: At the close, recovery health is ready AND no existing feature exit AND marked close greater than the same Config.fast simple moving average. Use only the supplied universe and observed prefix. Require the unchanged Config.recovery consecutive healthy closes. Actual full liquidation resets this counter; a requested or blocked exit is not a new flat campaign. Missing/unready, below-average or exit-warning closes reset health.
admission: Purchases still require the entire original support-budget allowed predicate on the current close, original ranking, vacancy, actual cash, support-distance budget, admission/sector caps, material additions, original risk-state authority and no unresolved protective inventory. Health alone never authorizes a purchase. Same-close exits veto additions. All support stops, actual-NAV history, T+1, blocked/partial orders, fixed analytical completion goals, costs and execution timing remain unchanged.
implementation: Add one explicit _readmission_health(i,allowed) extension point to support_budget.Owner whose default returns allowed unchanged. The new readmission.Owner fixes prior selected support parameters and changes only that health predicate. There is one empty-parameter candidate and no numeric search. Verify default old-parent decisions remain unchanged; old source-bound economic evidence is not relabeled as proof of this new owner.
selection: Reuse unchanged finite_study cutoff2025-12-31, three core scopes, incumbent-relative wealth/drawdown/fill minimax deficits, objective and tie-breaks. Exactly one candidate. Original windows, costs, statistics, universes, source identities and original acceptance obligations remain.

rejected_alternative: Do not combine this with wider mature-winner stops. In the common-five training evidence, the two mature stop-only exits without simultaneous account cuts have negative next20-session returns. Those diagnostic outcomes do not support blindly widening stops to fix the observed wealth gap.
raw_diagnostics: Preserve the exact original completion archive, original-source actual-inventory replay, per-close recovery-health witnesses, PnL attribution, source and runtime identity. No previous candidate grid or forecast is refitted or replayed to create these diagnostic observations.
limitations: Earlier readmission can buy losing opportunities; no promised improvement. Adjusted economic units remain a proxy, not a verified actual-share/corporate-action/tax ledger. Old failures and concurrent funded-intent work remain intact.
